new='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    if len(marks)<2: return out
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v and v!=5]
    def support(p):
        return sum(max(abs(r-p[0]),abs(c-p[1]))<=4 for r,c,v in cells)
    src=max(marks,key=support)
    dst=next((p for p in marks if p!=src),marks[0])
    for r,c,v in cells:
        rr,cc=dst[0]+r-src[0],dst[1]+c-src[1]
        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[rr][cc]=v
    out[dst[0]][dst[1]]=0
    return out
'''
